name: Stony Point Resort RV Park & Campground
note: Family resort on Cass Lake since 1939, just NE of town off US-2: full-hookup (30/50-amp) RV sites with concrete patios, many lining the resort's boat canal to the lake, plus wooded sites and pull-throughs; water/electric $49/night (2026). Swim beach, marina with boat rentals, indoor pool, Canal House restaurant. Open May 1 - Oct 15. RV Life 3.5*/$$, Good Sam 10/10/10. --Claude

name: Ringler Family Campground
note: Small family campground on MN-23 at 3064 State Hwy 23, Brook Park, between Mora and Hinckley: back-in and pull-through water-and-electric sites (15/30/50-amp, up to 70 ft) $50/night before tax (2026), booked online. --Claude
